about.headerText: Wɔ AcresxManna, yɛabɔ yɛn ho ama wiase aduane. Yɛwɔ anim sɛ yɛsɔ aduane ahobammɔ ne pa a ɛho hia a ɛredɔɔso no ano.
about.originParagraph1: AcresxManna Kuw no resesa sɛnea Afrika di aduane na ɛma wiase nso di. Yɛyɛ Afrika nyinaa agrofood kuw a yɛabɔ yɛn ho ama sɛ yɛbɛkyekye aduane daakye a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, a ɛkɔ so, na ɛyɛ pɛ ma obiara. Yɛn nhyehyɛeɛ ka kuayɛ, aduane siesie, sika, media, ne distribution bɔ mu—na ɛma aduane pa ne kwan wɔ agrofood value chain anammɔn biara mu. Yɛn adwumakuo no som akuraa adwumayɛfoɔ ne kurow mu atɔfoɔ nyinaa, na ɛde nneɛma foforɔ, nokorɛ, ne nkitahodi a ɛmu yɛ den wɔ mpɔtam mu ba. Yɛhwɛ sɛ yɛde ɛha nimdeɛ ne ɛnnɛ berɛ adwuma bɛka abɔ mu ama yɛahyɛ smallholder farmers den, ama aduane ahobammɔ ayɛ kɛse, na yɛde Afrika aduane ankasa nsɛm akɔ wiase nyinaa. Sɛ ɛyɛ afuo foforɔ, sika a obiara nya, logistics, anaa anansesɛm a wɔka kyerɛ, yɛn botaeɛ yɛ baako: sɛ yɛbɛbɔ nnipa nkwa, bɛkora agyanom amammerɛ so, na yɛbɛhyɛ sikasɛm den fi fapem so.
about.originParagraph2: Fi West Africa afuo nketewa so kɔ wiase aduane guasoɔ, wɔwoo AcresxManna Kuw no fii gyidie a ɛyɛ sɛ Afrika bɛtumi adi aduane—na ɛma wiase nso adi—wɔ nidi ne pɛyɛ mu. Yɛfii aseɛ ne botaeɛ baako: sɛ yɛbɛbɔ Afrika kuayɛ a ɛdɔɔso ne guasoɔ kwan ntam kwan. Wɔ kwan no so, yɛhunuu sɛ ɛho hia adeɛ bɛboro kuayɛ so. Yɛhunuu sɛ ɛho hia nhyehyɛeɛ, mmoa, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ adwuma—fi aba so kɔ shelf so. Ɛnnɛ, yɛn brands boa akuafoɔ wɔ kwan pa so, ma atɔfoɔ aduane pa, na wɔde Afrika amammerɛ anigyeɛ ba wiase nyinaa nkyɛn.
about.visionText: Sɛ yɛbɛboa kɛse ma wiase daakye a aduane wɔ mu na nnipa ahoɔden wɔ mu.
about.missionText: Sɛ yɛbɛkyekye afuo ne adwumakuo a ɛyɛ nneɛma pii na ɛwɔ ahoɔden a ɛyɛ adwuma paa wɔ sɛ ɛde boɔ a ɛho hia bɛka agrofood value chain no nyinaa mu.

businessFaq.heading: Nsɛm a Wɔtaa Bisa
businessFaq.faq0Question: Ayɔnkofa ahorow bɛn na wode ma?
businessFaq.faq0Answer: Yɛde ayɔnkofa hokwan ahodoɔ ma a nea ɛka ho ne adetɔnfoɔ fekubɔ, nkyekyɛmu apam, nneɛma a wɔyɛ abom, ne sika a wɔde bɛto mu hokwan. Wɔayɛ emu biara sɛnea ɔhokafo no ahiade pɔtee ne ne kɛse te.
businessFaq.faq1Question: Dɛn ne wo dodow a ɛba fam koraa a wobɛkra?
businessFaq.faq1Answer: Nneɛma dodow a wɔkra a ɛba fam koraa no gu ahorow wɔ nneɛma ne gua so. Wɔ nneɛma a wɔtɔn wɔ sotɔɔ mu ho no, yɛtaa fi ase fi 500 units. Wɔ nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma kɛse ne nea wɔde kɔ amannɔne ho no, wogyina nneɛma a wɔde gu mu ne nneɛma ko a wɔde gu mu so na ɛyɛ dodow a ɛba fam koraa ho nkitahodi.
businessFaq.faq2Answer: Yiw, yɛde nneɛma kɔ gua bɛboro 24 so wɔ wiase nyinaa denam Africa Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) akwan ne fekubɔ tẽẽ a yɛne EU ne North America a wɔde nneɛma ba amannɔne no yɛ so. Yɛn nneɛma no du amanaman ntam aduan ahobammɔ gyinapɛn ahorow ho.
businessFaq.faq3Answer: Yɛkura adansedie ahodoɔ pii a HACCP, ISO 22000, NAFDAC, SON, ne MAN ka ho. Saa adansedi ahorow yi hwɛ hu sɛ yɛn nneɛma no du aduan ahobammɔ, ne su, ne mmara gyinapɛn a ɛkorɔn sen biara ho wɔ gua ahorow so.
businessFaq.faq4Question: Mɛyɛ dɛn abɛyɛ obi a ɔde nneɛma ma?
businessFaq.faq4Answer: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ obi a ɔde nneɛma ma a, hyehyɛ yɛn adetɔnfo nsɛmmisa kratasin no hyehyɛ wo nneɛma, wo tumi, ne adansedi ahorow ho nsɛm. Yɛn adetɔ kuw no bɛhwɛ wo akwammisa krataa no mu na wɔne wo adi nkitaho wɔ adwuma nnafua 5 ntam ama anammɔn a edi hɔ no.
businessFaq.faq5Question: Tua ho nhyehyɛe bɛn na wode ma?
businessFaq.faq5Answer: Yɛde sikatua ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a egyina fekubɔ su ne nea wɔkra no kɛse so ma. Nsɛm a wɔtaa de di dwuma no bi ne nnafua 30-60 sika a wotua ma ahokafo a wɔatew wɔn ho, sika a wodi kan tua ma fekuw foforo, ne krataa a wɔde gye bosea ma amanaman ntam nneɛma a wɔde kɔ amannɔne.
businessFaq.faq6Question: So wode private label nnwuma ma?
businessFaq.faq6Answer: Yiw, yɛde private label ne white label manufacturing services ma ahokafo a wɔapaw wɔn. Eyi ka ho ne sɛnea wɔyɛ no sɛnea wɔpɛ, nneɛma a wɔde kyekyere nneɛma ho nhyehyɛe, ne nneɛma a wɔyɛ wɔ wo brand din ase a yɛn awerɛhyem sɛ ɛyɛ papa.
businessFaq.faq7Question: Dɛn ne bere a wode bedi dwuma wɔ nneɛma a wɔkra ho?
businessFaq.faq7Answer: Bere a wɔde di kan no gu ahorow wɔ nneɛma a wɔyɛ no mu: nneɛma a wɔasiesie no de kɔ wɔ adwuma nnafua 3-5 mu, amanneɛbɔ a wɔkra no gye adapɛn 2-4, na ahyɛde akɛse a wɔde kɔ amannɔne betumi ahwehwɛ adapɛn 4-8 a egyina nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde kɔ amannɔne so.
businessFaq.faq8Answer: Yiw, yɛde nneɛma nhwɛsode ma ma adwumayɛ ho nsɛmmisa a ɛfata. Wobetumi afa yɛn nkitahodi kratasin no so abisa nhwɛsode, na ebia wɔbɛbɔ ka a wɔbɔ wɔ nneɛma a wɔde mena ho a egyina beae ne nhwɛsode dodow so.
businessFaq.faq9Question: Nneɛma bɛn na wowɔ a ɛbɛma woatumi ahwɛ sɛnea nneɛma te yiye?
businessFaq.faq9Answer: Yɛde nneɛma a ɛyɛ papa ho nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den di dwuma wɔ ɔfã biara mu: afuw-pon ano a wɔde hyɛ mu, sɔhwɛ a wɔyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛe mu, nneɛma a wɔyɛ no mu nhwehwɛmu a etwa to, ne nokwaredi a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔde akɔma. Wɔde nnɛyi mfiri a wɔde sɔ hwɛ ahyɛ yɛn adwumayɛbea ahorow no mu na edi GMP gyinapɛn ahorow akyi.
businessFaq.faq10Question: So wubetumi adi nneɛma akɛse a wɔkra ho dwuma?
businessFaq.faq10Answer: Yiw, wɔayɛ yɛn adwumayɛbea ahorow no sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ nneɛma akɛse a ɛwɔ nhama pii a wɔde yɛ nneɛma ne nneɛma pii a wɔde sie. Yebetumi ayɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ no kɛse ma adi dodow a ɛho hia a ɛho hia ho dwuma bere a yɛkura gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa nneɛma pa ho no mu.
businessFaq.faq11Question: So woboa kuayɛ nneyɛe a ɛtra hɔ daa?
businessFaq.faq11Answer: Pɛpɛɛpɛ. Yɛne akuafoɔ yɛ adwuma yie de hyɛ nneyɛeɛ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa a asase a wɔbɛkora soɔ, nsuo a wɔde di dwuma, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma a wɔbɛtew so, ne abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom a wɔbɛkora soɔ ka ho ho nkuran. Yɛn kuayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no bi ne ntetee ne adansedi mmoa.
businessFaq.faq12Question: Wobɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ no yɛ nea ahobammɔ wom?
businessFaq.faq12Answer: Wɔnam akwan a HACCP agye atom, mmoawa nketenkete a wɔsɔ hwɛ daa, nneɛma a wɔkora so ne nea wɔde di dwuma ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata, nhyehyɛe a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma akyi, ne amanaman ntam aduan ho ahobammɔ ho mmara a USFDA ne EU gyinapɛn ahorow ka ho a wodi so na ɛhwɛ ma nneɛma no yɛ ahobammɔ.
